d:
Before any wedding, comes the fun-fun for the whole family. Nachde Ne Saare is a tongue-in-cheek song where the entire cast of Baar Baar Dekho comes together to join the happy couple. Katrina Kaif delights us with playful dance moves along with Sidharth Malhotra, Sarika, Ram Kapoor, Taaha Shah, Sayani Gupta and Rohan Joshi.
Presenting the full video of Nachde Ne Saare sung by Jasleen Royal, Harshdeep Kaur & Siddharth Mahadevan.
Song Name - Nachde Ne Saare
Movie - Baar Baar Dekho
Music - Jasleen Royal
Singer - Jasleen Royal, Harshdeep Kaur & Siddharth Mahadevan
Lyrics - Aditya Sharma
